mapper.select: SELECT raw_attendance_fact_id, attendance_source_id, legal_entity_id, fact_kind, source_business_key, source_version, stable_fingerprint, source_time_text, source_time_zone, source_instant, interval_start, interval_end, canonical_payload_digest, raw_object_ref, request_id, received_at, created_by FROM raw_attendance_fact WHERE attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND stable_fingerprint = #{stableFingerprint}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO raw_attendance_fact ( raw_attendance_fact_id, attendance_source_id, legal_entity_id, fact_kind, source_business_key, source_version, stable_fingerprint, source_time_text, source_time_zone, source_instant, interval_start, interval_end, canonical_payload_digest, raw_object_ref, request_id, received_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{rawAttendanceFactId}, #{attendanceSourceId}, #{legalEntityId}, #{factKind}, #{sourceBusinessKey}, #{sourceVersion}, #{stableFingerprint}, #{sourceTimeText}, #{sourceTimeZone}, #{sourceInstant}, #{intervalStart}, #{intervalEnd}, #{canonicalPayloadDigest}, #{rawObjectRef}, #{requestId}, #{receivedAt}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO normalized_attendance_record ( normalized_attendance_record_id, raw_attendance_fact_id, normalization_revision, schema_version, record_kind, normalized_direction, point_instant, interval_start, interval_end, validation_status, issue_code, canonical_digest, supersedes_normalized_record_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{normalizedAttendanceRecordId}, #{rawAttendanceFactId}, #{normalizationRevision}, #{schemaVersion}, #{recordKind}, #{normalizedDirection}, #{pointInstant}, #{intervalStart}, #{intervalEnd}, #{validationStatus}, #{issueCode}, #{canonicalDigest}, #{supersedesNormalizedRecordId}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT event.effective_attendance_event_id, event.legal_entity_id, event.employee_id, event.event_kind, event.normalized_direction, event.point_instant, event.interval_start, event.interval_end, event.canonical_digest, event.created_at FROM effective_attendance_event event WHERE event.legal_entity_id = #{legalEntityId} AND event.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND event.point_instant = #{pointInstant} AND event.normalized_direction = #{normalizedDirection} AND ( SELECT lifecycle.lifecycle_type FROM effective_event_lifecycle_fact lifecycle WHERE lifecycle.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id ORDER BY lifecycle.knowledge_at DESC, lifecycle.effective_event_lifecycle_fact_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) = 'ACTIVATED' ORDER BY event.effective_attendance_event_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_recalculation_intent ( attendance_recalculation_intent_id, legal_entity_id, employee_id, business_date, reason_code, effective_attendance_event_id, resolver_snapshot_digest, period_version, request_id, intent_digest, created_at ) VALUES ( #{attendanceRecalculationIntentId}, #{legalEntityId}, #{employeeId}, #{businessDate}, #{reasonCode}, #{effectiveAttendanceEventId}, #{resolverSnapshotDigest}, #{periodVersion}, #{requestId}, #{intentDigest}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT event.effective_attendance_event_id, lifecycle.lifecycle_type, lifecycle.knowledge_at, link.evidence_link_id, raw.raw_attendance_fact_id, raw.attendance_source_id, raw.fact_kind, raw.source_business_key, raw.source_version, raw.canonical_payload_digest, normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id, normalized.validation_status AS normalization_status, matched.employee_match_decision_id, matched.match_status, matched.match_reason FROM effective_attendance_event event JOIN effective_event_lifecycle_fact lifecycle ON lifecycle.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id JOIN evidence_link link ON link.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id JOIN raw_attendance_fact raw ON raw.raw_attendance_fact_id = link.raw_attendance_fact_id JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id = link.normalized_attendance_record_id JOIN employee_match_decision matched ON matched.employee_match_decision_id = link.employee_match_decision_id WHERE event.legal_entity_id = #{legalEntityId} AND event.effective_attendance_event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY lifecycle.knowledge_at, lifecycle.effective_event_lifecycle_fact_id, link.evidence_link_id
